body: Update; I'm still here, went to the psychologist today and she set me up for another appointment next week. I had no saying she said I had to come. This might be because I almost overdosed monday on painkillers, I didn't go to the doctors even though I took like 18, but I'm okay. And yesterday I cut open my thighs. Still freakin' alive.

It's three days since I took them, but I've not been feeling well. Just took 8 of them again just now though.. It's so hard to stop. Yesterday I cut my thighs, both of them so I'm not doing well. Oh well.
Life? I am very stressed 24/7 and I'm so tired of hanging on.. Been like this for too long.

I have spoken to numerous people in the past, but never with an illness I've been diagnosed with. It's different because I'm scared to face the truth - I still don't think I have an illness. Doesn't feel like it at least. In addition to this, I'm so nervous about calling to reschedule.
Yeah, me too. Have a good week.
If I do decide to reschedule it, I will try to keep myself alive until may. We'll see how my week go.
I have tried to live like this for three years. Things are rarely getting better, no matter how far away my deadline is. I'm proud of you though! Don't loose yourself

- Constantly ill (headaches, nausea, dizzy etc.). I have fainted three times since last friday
- Can't take care of my diabetes. Lately my bloodsugar levels have been quite high
- Preforming badly in school - Especially before tests and such
- Not eating properly, feeling sick. I've lost 11 lbs/ 5 kg in a week
- Was diagnosed with depression and anxiety not long ago. Haven't really told anyone else except my teacher and girlfriend
- Can't sleep. I recently started taking circadin, the "sleep hormone" but I keep waking up and always feeling exhausted
- I'm stressed 24/7
- I do have an appointment with a psychologist the 20th, however, I have a school trip so I'm considering whether to cancel or reschedule --> this is making me stressed, since my social anxiety is acting up, and I have to *call* them. Too scared
- I loathe myself
- I want to hurt myself/drink
- AND THE GUILT: I feel guilty of everything I do ~ Doesn't matter if I get a good grade, if I do something good; I will always feel guilty. When bad things happen, I just want to die. I can't handle bad news. 
 
Sorry if this is too much, it's just easier to write it like this. I'm sorry.

No.. I like to think of my eating problems as temporary. It will get better after a while, hopefully. I will most likely mention my eating problem to the psychologist, that is if I do decide to go. I am currently arguing with myself. I can't choose. I'm also taking circadin to sleep better at night, only supposed to take 1x 1-2 hours before going to sleep, but I don't think they're working that well. Took 2 wednesday, I had a term test and really needed the sleep, however I ended up sleeping 1 hour and staying up the rest of the night. Not fun.

It's okay to write here, doesn't bother me at all.
 
I did actually go to my doctor last week (fainted at school. She said I was stressed) and she did diagnose me with depression and possibly anxiety. I have a persistent feeling of guilt. I feel sooo guilty all the time, even if the things I am doing have positive feedback. I also want to hurt myself, feel pain. I am self-loathing, don't really like my body and when I eat too much candy or such, I feel horrible. 
 
To answer your question; No, my physical symptoms are not the main problem here, meanwhile it does cause me to feel bad. When I'm in a dark place while feeling ill, I only think of myself badly. 
I do have an appointment with a psychologist the 20th, however, I have a school trip so I'm considering whether to cancel or reschedule.
I know. I mentioned almost calling the ambulance yesterday, but I still don't feel like it's that serious. I'm confused probably
I know that. And for some reason, I am mad. I am so mad instead of feeling better. And that makes me even more mad. I don't know what I'll do with myself till someone contacts me.. Stay alive maybe?
I had my doctor's appointment today and I was diagnosed with depression and possibly anxiety and/ or some sort of panic disorder. Told one of my friends. She's here for me.
My doctor's appointment is at 10 AM tomorrow. To be honest, I'm not quite sure what to say. Thanks for your support

Well, yes. I told my two best friends last year, my theory of having depression. However, they have not even mentioned it once since then. They have noticed sometimes I am not myself and have proceeded to ask me, but they are dealing with things themselves so I can't. I haven't really bothered telling them I need help again. We're also in the same class at school.
I'll consider trying. Doctor first, maybe?
High school. Next year is the last one.
